statusDetail: All 58 atomic checks were judged across four representative content templates plus error, preference, performance, security, discoverability and memory conditions.

page.framework: Legacy server templates enhanced with jQuery/Swiper and AJAX modules

paths.description: Mobile landing page: global navigation, search, content modules and primary outbound reading choices.
Representative news article template and long-form reading path.
Nonexistent route used to inspect HTTP/error recovery.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference
findings.evidence: The normal and dark-condition screenshots are visually identical white interfaces, and computed html color-scheme is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, icon and form-control colors.

findings.summary: Route changes use abrupt full-document swaps
findings.evidence: Representative navigation between home, article and board templates showed unrelated hard cuts and no authored view-transition CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for same-origin template navigation, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-state orientation
findings.evidence: The 3,706 px home page and 18,513 px board detail use static chrome with no progress cue or scroll-state responsive header.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress or scroll-state-aware compact header for long reading surfaces.

findings.summary: Floating ads obscure primary content
findings.evidence: Article and board screenshots show a persistent floating ad covering text or post media, with a small close control.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer nonessential ads, reserve non-overlapping placements, and make any user-invoked overlay clearly dismissible.

findings.summary: Dismissible floating UI uses custom div-based controls
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS evidence identifies .mobileDaNsFloat and custom 16 px close anchors rather than dialog/popover semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the appropriate popover or dialog primitive, declarative light-dismiss, an accessible name, and a 44 px target.

findings.summary: Dense chrome and ads compete with content
findings.evidence: Board templates devote multiple stacked navigation rows and a floating ad to chrome; the detail page’s post content starts below 230 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate secondary navigation and remove overlapping ad chrome so content dominates the first viewport.

findings.summary: Components rely on global layout rather than container responsiveness
findings.evidence: The CSS/DOM probe found no @container rules or container-type on representative components.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reusable cards, nav groups and board modules that appear at different widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and many targets are undersized
findings.evidence: The focus probe found outline:none on visible links and inputs; 66 of the first 100 controls measured below 44 px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styles and enlarge icon, close and compact navigation hit areas to at least 44 by 44 CSS px.

findings.summary: Largest content paint is extremely slow
findings.evidence: Trace measured FCP 11.48 s and LCP 20.62 s; Lighthouse performance scored 0.55.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP image, shorten critical dependency chains, defer ads/analytics, and optimize font loading.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is blocked by a long legacy dependency chain
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 223 requests and 7.74 MB; Lighthouse found render-blocking savings of 9.19 s, a 9.95 s longest chain, short cache lifetimes and blocking fonts.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline or split critical CSS, defer noncritical scripts, add font-display, improve caching, modernize HTTP delivery and prioritize the LCP asset.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused CSS and JavaScript
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 423 KiB unused JS and 83 KiB unused CSS; duplicated analytics and ad libraries dominate the unused code.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics, load ad modules conditionally, tree-shake page bundles and split template-specific CSS.

findings.summary: Key controls and images lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an unnamed search button and 11 unnamed links; the image audit found 37 images without alt and the DOM probe found two unlabelled search inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Name icon controls, associate visible labels with inputs, and provide meaningful alt text or empty alt for decoration.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s color-contrast audit failed 21 elements on the home template.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background design tokens to meet WCAG AA in default and high-contrast modes.

findings.summary: Pages lack a main landmark and visible focus
findings.evidence: All four templates had no main element; home had no h1, while focused visible controls commonly computed outline:none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a single main landmark, a descriptive h1 per template and consistent :focus-visible styling in DOM reading order.

findings.summary: The viewport disables user zoom
findings.evidence: The viewport is user-scalable=no with maximum-scale=1; Lighthouse meta-viewport failed, and many controls are smaller than 44 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1, verify 200–400% reflow, and enlarge touch targets.

findings.summary: The page logs browser errors
findings.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console failed and the HAR recorded a 404 for html-load.com/script.min.js.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or correct the broken third-party loader and gate optional integrations so failures do not reach the console.

findings.summary: Image assets are structurally and visually inefficient
findings.evidence: All 99 audited images lack width/height attributes, 19 display at incorrect aspect ratios, and 29 are oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions, preserve aspect ratios, and generate responsive sources at rendered sizes.

findings.summary: Legacy libraries and inspector issues weaken platform hygiene
findings.evidence: The page loads jQuery 1.9.1, Lighthouse recorded cookie inspector issues and a broken source map, and 14 javascript: links were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace javascript: anchors with buttons, update legacy dependencies, repair source maps and resolve DevTools Issues.

findings.summary: Important controls use uncrawlable javascript: links and zoom-hostile viewport settings
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found 14 javascript: links; Lighthouse crawlable-anchors failed, and the viewport blocks zoom.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs for navigation and buttons for actions; keep a mobile viewport without disabling scaling.

findings.summary: Pages omit canonical URL signals
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no rel=canonical on the public home page, despite valid robots and a successful response.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish self-referential canonicals for public templates and keep them consistent with sitemap and redirects.

findings.summary: HTTPS is served without core security headers and cookies are insecure
findings.evidence: Headers found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff; all eight first-party cookies lacked Secure and used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP, HSTS and nosniff; mark cookies Secure and choose Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is necessary.

findings.summary: The page has a broad tracking and third-party footprint
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 27 third-party origins and seven known trackers; HAR classified 202 of 223 requests and 7.69 MB as cross-origin to m.inven.co.kr.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit necessity, remove duplicate trackers, obtain meaningful consent where required, batch analytics and delay nonessential third parties.

findings.summary: The exposed login path shows no phishing-resistant authentication support
findings.evidence: Activating the login control left a JavaScript/hidden-form flow; loaded scripts contained no PublicKeyCredential integration. No unsolicited permission prompt was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey/WebAuthn sign-in or reauthentication alongside recovery options, initiated from an explicit user action.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defense policies are absent
findings.evidence: The main document lacked HSTS, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, as well as CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy; consider Trusted Types for legacy DOM-heavy code.

findings.summary: Most content disappears without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 4% raw-to-rendered content coverage; the crawler screenshot contains only footer chrome while the rendered page is content-rich.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core headlines, links and article content, then enhance carousels, ads and personalization with JavaScript.

findings.summary: Images are neither modern nor appropriately sized
findings.evidence: The image audit found 99 legacy-format images, 51 without srcset and 29 oversized; Lighthouse estimates 4.98 MB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, responsive srcset/sizes, intrinsic dimensions and correctly compressed thumbnails.

findings.summary: Large amounts of code and content are fetched without immediate user value
findings.evidence: The home load transfers 7.74 MB across 223 requests, including 423 KiB estimated unused JS and many below-fold images loaded eagerly.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold media, conditionally load modules, defer background analytics and remove unused code.

findings.summary: Third-party and media weight is disproportionate for a news landing page
findings.evidence: Images transfer 5.33 MB, fonts 1.08 MB, and tracked/cross-origin resources account for nearly all 7.74 MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a page-weight budget, subset fonts, defer ads/media and remove third parties that do not provide proportional user value.

findings.summary: The home page has a large initial memory footprint
findings.evidence: The baseline heap summary contains 533,023 nodes and 29.6 MB self size for a mobile news landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce DOM duplication, virtualize or defer below-fold modules, and avoid initializing hidden carousels and ad slots up front.
